content.text:
I submitted **index 1 (Sb fraction 0.146)** as the best composition. Its EQE of **0.248%** was the highest of the five I measured.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.134 | 0.227 |
| **1** | **0.146** | **0.248** |
| 5 | 0.210 | 0.184 |
| 15 | 0.493 | 0.083 |
| 24 | 0.775 | 0.084 |

- **Trend:** EQE is highest on the indium-rich end and falls as antimony increases. Index 1 scored higher than index 0 at 0.134, so the peak is probably near 0.146. With only five measurements, though, it could lie between 0.146 and 0.21 (indices 2–4), which I didn't measure.
- **Structure:** I used 3 of the 5 XRD scans (indices 1, 5 and 9). All three show the same main pattern. It matches a known indium–antimony oxide with about 21% Sb (In11Sb3O24) best at Sb 0.146 and less well at 0.30 (similarity 0.56 vs 0.40). That fits a better-ordered phase on the low-Sb side, but the match is only moderate.

The full EQE budget (5) is spent; 2 XRD scans were left unused. The submission went through.
